mira_cs: Everleaf Therapeutics (trial) emailed asking for a Brazil peering + rolling burst allowance for an in-region stress demo. Need allowlist + header HMAC + a billing safety valve. Can we triage?

ton y_ops: Hosted API? CIDRs and exact window?

mira_cs: Hosted. Contact: hana@everleaf.bio. Window: 2026-11-20 12:00 -> 2026-11-22 18:00 BRT. They plan sustained 90 QPS with rolling bursts up to 400 QPS (10m bursts every 2h during business hours). CIDRs: 3.80.0.0/16 and 2001:0db8:9abc::/48. Header HMAC: X-EV-SIG (HMAC-SHA256).

yara_net: We can do v4+v6 allowlist and HMAC check via short-lived validator. Rolling bursts are fine but we should limit total token spend and enable KV-prefix caching. Recommend billing cap $1,200 for the window and auto-revoke after 2026-11-22.

ton y_ops: I'll propose a feature-flagged route (ff:everleaf-br) and canary plan 3-step: 2% -> 20% -> 100%. Add emergency throttle command.

evan_pm: Renewal touchpoint in Jan; capture latency, token-cost, and customer feedback. This stress demo could influence conversion. I'll prepare a short eval: p50/p95 latency, token-cost delta, HMAC failure rate, routing correctness, and a 3-question survey.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-4102 created: "Everleaf Brazil rolling-burst demo + HMAC". Owners: tony_ops, yara_net. Calendar event added.

mira_cs: Owners assigned: mira (customer comms + consent), tony (ops rollout + billing cap), yara (edge + validator), evan (eval + renewal). I'll attach consent and key rotation schedule to CS-4102.

yara_net: Edge snippet for proxy team: ```allowlist_ips:["3.80.0.0/16","2001:0db8:9abc::/48"] header_hmac:{header:"X-EV-SIG",algo:"HMAC-SHA256",key_id:"ev-demo-2026-11"} region_route:"sa-east1" rate_limit_override:{sustained_qps:90,burst_qps:400,burst_pattern:"rolling:10m@2h"} auto_revoke:true```

ton y_ops: I'll add runbook command `rb throttle cs-4102 --qps 60` and set a billing-override flag to stop any overrun. Canary plan will execute two days before window.

mira_cs: I'll send acceptance + data handling consent and confirm they agree to the $1,200 cap and key rotation cadence.

yara_net: After the window we'll rotate/disable keys and remove allowlist. Export usage snapshot and a short post-demo note on any egress charges.

ton y_ops: Closing loop  once canary is green we'll request explicit go/no-go from Hana and proceed. Thanks all.
